title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.16207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed agent; and an operator-chosen per-problem cost target - usually set at an incumbent's own price - RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent, evolves complete agent programs that attack the public frontiers of two semantically dissimilar tasks point by point: DS-1000 (execution-checked code generation) and PaperFindingBench (LLM-judged scientific document retrieval). Our officially scored submissions hold every Pareto-frontier slot but one on the two task

translated_title: 在每个价格点上通过LLM菜单上的智能体进化参与竞争
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16207v1 公告类型：新 摘要：考虑一家公司调查其在特定智能体任务上的竞争情况，并寻求在每个竞争对手价格点上提供更优的准确性。若一家公司在帕累托效率上超越其竞争对手，那么理性的客户就没有理由转向别处购买。本文展示了一条通过LLM菜单上的智能体进化实现这种能力的路径，训练池中最多包含100个示例。给定一个包含九个LLM端点的定价菜单、任务目标与API的简要文档、一个简单的种子智能体，以及操作者选择的每问题成本目标（通常设定为现有竞争者的价格），RoboPhD，一个进化型元智能体，能够逐步进化出完整的智能体程序，针对两个语义上不相似的任务的前沿进行逐点攻击：DS-1000（执行检查的代码生成）和PaperFindingBench（LLM评判的科学文献检索）。我们官方评分的提交在两个任务上占据了除一个之外的所有帕累托前沿槽位。
tldr: 本文提出RoboPhD，一种通过进化式智能体在LLM菜单上自动生成程序的方法，以在多个价格点上实现帕累托优势，用极少训练示例在两项任务上几乎占据全部前沿。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent that evolves complete agent programs over a menu of LLMs to achieve Pareto dominance at every price point, using minimal training examples to capture nearly all frontier slots on two tasks.
